Deerling

Normal Grass

Unova · Generation 5

Deerling is a Normal/Grass-type Season Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 19.5 kg. It evolves into Sawsbuck. Its highest base stat is Speed (75), with a base stat total of 335.
